rows.text:
In the year 2147 of the Light Calendar, the holy city faced the calamity of the black tide and faded into the night.
This tome chronicles the fallen and records the sorrow of Okhema.

Fallen Soldiers, Priests, and Scholars
...

• Alpheus and Malonza – Twin brothers who perished for the holy city.
{TEXTJOIN#216}{TEXTJOIN#217}{TEXTJOIN#218}{TEXTJOIN#219}
Fallen Citizens
...

• Antigone – Daughter of Acacias, perished in a collapsed home.

• Theagis – A mother of three, perished embracing her youngest.
{TEXTJOIN#220}{TEXTJOIN#221}{TEXTJOIN#222}{TEXTJOIN#223}{TEXTJOIN#224}



Missing Persons
• Hegesia – A humble soul, missing.

Others
• Ten unidentified bodies, features unrecognizable.

...

May the grace of Thanatos guide these souls to a new world.
We shall meet again at the end of the west wind.
